front.title: Client ID Metadata Document Software Statement

abstract.t: This specification defines a software statement in which a trusted party records its review of the exact octets of a client's Client ID Metadata Document (CIMD), and how an authorization server enforces that review when it admits the client at request time, without a registration. A CIMD carries the client's own metadata, which can change at any time, and a statement binds the review to one version of the document by its digest. The client presents the statement in a token or pushed authorization request, or publishes it where its document points. The authorization server accepts a statement only from an issuer it trusts, and also binds the presenter to the reviewed document, although for a public client that binding does not hold against a party that controls the user agent. Independently operated authorization servers can consume the same review, each under its own trust configuration and admission policy.
